info.name: Radiology Appointment Management System
info.description:
All API endpoints for the radiology appointment management system.

Base URL: `http://localhost:4000/api/v1`

Most successful responses use the shared `ApiResponse` shape:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "statusCode": 200,
  "message": "Success",
  "data": {}
}
```
Errors (validation via zod / global error handler) use:
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "statusCode": 400,
  "message": "...",
  "errors": []
}
```

item.name: Categories
item.description: CRUD for radiology categories. Categories are referenced by radiologies, partners (profit share) and branches (available radiology).

response.name: Already Exists
Validation Error (missing name)

request.description:
Path param `id`: valid ObjectId of the category.
Body: `{ "name": string }`
Deletes the category and all radiologies belonging to it. Returns 204 No Content.

item.name: Radiologies
item.description: CRUD for radiology exams. Each radiology belongs to a category and has a price for every branch.

response.name: Success

request.description:
Body:
- `name` (string, required, min 1)
- `prices` (array, required — one { branch, price } entry per branch; must cover every branch)
- `category` (string, required, valid category ObjectId)

response.name: Created
Validation Error (invalid payload)
response.body:
{
  "success": false,
  "statusCode": 400,
  "message": "Name cannot be empty & invalid branch id & Price must be a positive number & invalid category id",
  "errors": [
    "Name cannot be empty",
    "invalid branch id",
    "Price must be a positive number",
    "invalid category id"
  ]
}

request.description: Partial update — send any fields present on the radiology model (`name`, `prices`, `category`). When `prices` is sent it must include a price for every branch.

response.name: Success

item.name: Partners
item.description: CRUD for partners with per-category profit share percentages.

request.description:
Body:
- `name` (string, optional)
- `profitShare` (array, required): each item `{ category: ObjectId, value: number }`

response.name: Created
Already Exists
Validation Error

request.description: `profitShare` items are merged by `category`: existing categories get updated values, new categories are appended.

item.name: Clients
item.description: Read-only client endpoints. Clients are created automatically when a reservation is created.

item.name: Reservations
item.description: Appointments. A reservation is created together with (or reuses) a client, and is linked to branch + partner + radiologies.

response.name: Success

request.description:
Body:
- `date` (string, required, ISO datetime)
- `notes` (string, optional)
- `branch` (string, required, branch ObjectId)
- `radiologies` (string[], required, radiology ObjectIds)
- `fromPartner` (string, required, partner ObjectId)
- `clientName` (string, required)
- `clientAge` (number, required)
- `clientPhone` (string, required)

If a client with the same `clientName` already exists, that client is reused.

response.name: Created
Validation Error (missing/invalid fields)
